title: A Study of IBI363 in Subjects with Advanced Solid Malignancies
official: A Phase 2, Open-label, Multicenter Study of IBI363 (PD1-IL2m) in Subjects with Advanced Solid Malignancies
summary: This is a Phase 2, open-label, multicenter study designed to evaluate the efficacy, safety and tolerability of IBI363 (study drug) in subjects with advanced, refractory solid malignancies.
